source.title: Ashenvale Mission VI: Treant Intelligence
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Warsong Lumber Camp. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Lanaria there and return to me.
source.objective: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Lanaria in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion inside Kargathia Keep at the Warsong Lumber Camp and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
